questions.passage: In 1869, at age twenty-four, he was appointed chair of classical philology (the study of the history of languages) at Basel University, the youngest ever appointed to the post. In 1876, an illness forced him to take leave from Basel. This prolonged illness gave him a chance to change his habits completely. It helped him detach himself from typical conventions.
questions.prompt: Why did Nietzsche take leave from Basel in 1876?
questions.promptZh: Nietzsche 在 1876 年为何从 Basel 请假？
options: He retired immediately on being appointed in 1869.
He voluntarily took a break solely to accept a new university post.
He left because he had completed all his research and had nothing left to think about.
An illness forced him to take leave.
optionsZh: 他在1869年刚获任时立即退休。
他纯为接受另一大学职位而自愿休假。
他因研究全部完成、再无可思考的问题而离开。
疾病迫使他请假。
analyses: A 1869是任命，1876才是此句请假；appointed不是retired。
B forced与自愿不同，且没有接受新职位的原因。
C 后面还要谈思想与习惯变化，原句未给研究完毕的原因。
D an illness forced him 明确给请假原因；take leave 不自动等于被开除或永久辞职。

vocabulary.context: 此处由疾病迫使其离岗，不是凭该短语就可确认永久解职。
vocabulary.example: The lecturer had to take leave because of illness.

questions.passage: During illness, he felt that he was returning to his natural self. “Looking from the perspective of the sick toward healthier concepts and values and, conversely, looking again from the fullness and self-assurance of a rich life down into the secret work of the instinct of decadence…Now I know how, have the know-how, to reverse perspectives.” Nietzsche credited his illness as a source of perspective change and wisdom, suggesting that adversity has the potential to generate psychological richness.
questions.prompt: How does the author qualify the link between adversity and richness?
options: Adversity guarantees wisdom for everyone.
Adversity has the potential to produce psychological richness.
Only illness can ever change perspectives.
Nietzsche’s account is presented as a controlled experiment.
questions.promptZh: 作者怎样限定逆境与丰富的联系？
optionsZh: 保证人人智慧。
有潜力产生心理丰富。
只有疾病能变视角。
当作受控实验。
analyses: A potential 是潜力，不是保证。
B 最后 suggesting...potential 精确保留限定。
C 个人来源不能改成唯一途径。
D 是个人引用及作者阐释，不是试验。正反视角切换不表示否认痛苦。
